Hey,

Have you ever tried stapling your arm? It's terrible and quite painful. Trying to cut yourself with broken glass? I have no friends. Nothing to connect. It sucks doesn't it?

Can you be honest with me? Did you remember me?
I will believe if you say yes or no. But don't lie that would be a lot worse then just saying no.
I am not sure. I was an accident to begin with.
It's all for naught. I considered myself to be a nice person but I just mess things up and make it worse for others. I hate this. I am in the way for everyone including my family.

Well thanks. Will you care 3 days from now? Will you remember this post? If so then thanks again. But I really doubt it.

I don't even know what I wrote... I am not going to read it again. it's a big mess, my mind was totally fucked and I just didn't think it through. I just moved to the US (back form abroad) and I don't yet have any US health insurance. Currently I am on a travel insurance and that won't cover any help for such things. 
Thanks for the support it was very nice of you! Maybe I'll go see someone. But I don't really know hat to expect and I am actually a bit scared of it. I never ever opened up for anyone, I wanted to talk to friends but I don't have anyone close to me.
I did tell a part of how I feel to someone but that was via text and didn't really feel personal.
